thread:
sasha: Quick flag 4 we've got mixed client metadata shapes landing in headers from py/ts/go. Dashboard shows split quota attribution. Can we standardize?

mike: Example?

sasha: TS: `X-Redwood-Meta: route=chat.v1;cost_center=eng;sid=abc123`
Py: `X-Redwood-Meta: {"route":"chat.v1","team":"eng","sid":"abc123"}`
Go: `X_Redwood_Meta: route=chat.v1|cc=eng|session:abc123`

leon: Permissive SDK helpers caused divergence. We should pick one canonical format.

mike: Proposal: canonical JSON header `X-Redwood-Context` with keys: `route`, `cost_center`, `session_id`, `env`, `client_version`. Accept legacy for a migration window.

anya: Console wants telemetry flag when legacy is seen so we can show % migrated and a tile listing customers (hashed). Also filter by route/client_version.

leon: SDK plan: opt-in bool in next minor to emit canonical JSON, warning logs when legacy detected, full default in next major. Provide `redwood.context.normalize()` helper to convert legacy -> canonical.

mike: Proxy modes: 1) passthrough+telemetry, 2) normalize (rewrite), 3) enforce (reject). Rollout: opt-in 6w, normalize 4w, enforce 8w.

deploy-bot: policy-proxy v2.14.0 canary: passthrough+telemetry active in us-west-2.

sasha: Action items: leon -> helpers + opt-in + logs; anya -> telemetry counters + console tile; mike -> RFC + rollout timeline. Thanks :thumbsup:
